summary: 人口拖累真实且大量级:总人口2023年起绝对下降,生育率约1.18,UN预测2050年降至13.13亿;劳动年龄人口2013见顶、2024→2050约-2.39亿(-22%)。这是潜在增长的确定性向下压力。

evidence.title: Pew: China's declining population
evidence.quote: China is now projected to experience an absolute decline in its population beginning as early as 2023.

evidence.title: Pew/UN population projection
evidence.quote: The UN forecasts that China's population will decline from 1.426 billion this year to 1.313 billion by 2050 and below 800 million by 2100.
